name: encoding-reflection-template-the-analysis-cannot-read
description: A template the analysis cannot read, parsed from a string read at run time or invoked by a name only such a template defines, can name any exported field of the execution's argument or print it, but the analysis reads it as an action of a template it does not read: it reads of the argument's fields only those the program writes, so an exported field nothing writes and an unexported field are reported as never written.
